implementation: Private build rewrites six generated high-level optional-u32 getter bodies to their generated word-returning equivalents. Public method names, argument names and TypeScript signatures are preserved. Native word-buffer cleanup is retained; each result is decoded once, without fallback or retry. Default shipping artifacts are unchanged.

checks.externalPackedConsumer: Node, TypeScript, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit passed

limitations: Low-level raw Wasm InitOutput legacy exports still retain their original ABI; this experiment changes generated high-level class methods only.
Not a proven WebKit engine-internal diagnosis or complete fix qualification.
Native clipboard, physical IME and screen-reader gates remain separate and open.
Default package-size ceilings are exceeded; no larger budget is implicitly accepted.
Stress runs are correctness evidence, not accepted latency or p95 qualification.
commandCorrection: The first typed stress invocation used BREDITOR_PERF_OWNERS rather than BREDITOR_PERF_OWNER_REPETITIONS and was rejected before fixture creation. The corrected invocation is retained separately; this was a command configuration error, not an editor failure.
